scope: Unprivileged trainable write gate on original TTTLinearMemory online matrix equation; independent authored DEV only; not original full Hybrid, not externally authenticated physical source or scientific first use
hypothesis: A learned content-sensitive write gate will retain stable action-consequence mappings through overlapping nuisance observations better than unfiltered reference writes, nonlearned surprise filtering, equal memory FIFO, and a separately fully trained GRU.

generation.target_values: fixed per-action tanh Gaussian realized outcomes
generation.distractors: independent normalized action vectors and tanh Gaussian observed outcomes; overlapping or orthogonal to target subspace
generation.order: per-world seeded interleaving; no phase labels at model input
generation.supervision: query-target values only in training objective and evaluation scoring, never inside online write gate

arms: random admission rate matched to learned FIT gate
8-pair FIFO memory using same 256 state floats
fully trained GRU(32 input,24 hidden) recurrence with query readout
privileged oracle phase selector (diagnostic ceiling only)

training.loss: full-stream final target query MSE + 0.1 midpoint target query MSE
training.gru_input: observed action and realized consequence only
training.optimizer_controls: same training sample-index plan, Adam steps and learning rate for gate and GRU

metrics: unfamiliar target MSE, per trained seed
per-arm wall clock including training and inference

strict_dev_success.wrong_credit: wrong-credit gate OOD MSE >=1.2*intact gate MSE

limitations: DEV synthetic actions and outcomes only; original trained Mamba2+attention+TTT+MoD not instantiated; not capacity/compute matched to GRU, no external first-use; cannot claim scientific pass, promotion, or integration even if DEV thresholds pass.
on_failure: Report all nulls without post-result tuning; do not reuse OOD cohort for a revised hypothesis.
authority: No merge, workflow, runner, owner, controller, scheduler, paid API, live action, protected source first-use, or FORGE modification
